purpose: Teach: デュアル/ダイアログ/コンパイル/アンカー/グリッド/シールド/レビューア/コストパフォーマンス
target_vocab: コストパフォーマンス

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査車両のデュアル装備、つまり二系統装備を導入されますね
lines.en: Police departments are introducing dual-system equipment for patrol vehicles, then.
lines.style: Measured, methodical tone. Speaking as though checking off procedural steps. Neutral, informative pace. Slight upward lilt on the closing particle—observing rather than questioning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者とのダイアログ、つまり対話記録を整えられますね
lines.en: Police are documenting dialogue records with suspects carefully, then.
lines.style: Same measured rhythm as before. Quiet confidence in the process being described. No rush. The tone of someone noting procedure without judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収プログラムのコンパイル解析もされますね
lines.en: Police are also conducting compilation analysis on seized programs, then.
lines.style: Continuing the same even-handed enumeration. Slightly technical in delivery—precise but not cold. Steady eye contact with the process itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民会見のアンカー、つまり司会担当も慎重に選ばれますね
lines.en: Police are selecting the anchor for public briefings with appropriate care, then.
lines.style: Acknowledging the human element now. Tone softens infinitesimally—still measured, but carrying weight. The word 'appropriate' lands with quiet significance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場地図にグリッドを引いて捜査されますね
lines.en: Police are marking out grids on scene maps for investigation, then.
lines.style: Back to the systematic enumeration. Visual and spatial—you can almost see the grid being drawn. Unhurried. Each element confirmed rather than explained.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防護シールド装備の研修も実施されますね
lines.en: Police are also conducting training on protective shield equipment, then.
lines.style: The list continues with the same patient rhythm. Practical and grounded. No inflection change—these are all equally important steps in the process.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、外部レビューア、つまり評価者を捜査プロセスに招き入れますね
lines.en: Police are bringing external reviewers into the investigation process, then.
lines.style: Slight warmth enters here—acknowledgment of outside oversight. Still measured, but with a hint that this openness is intentional. Calm confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、装備のコストパフォーマンスを定期評価されますね
lines.en: Police are also conducting regular cost-performance evaluations of equipment, then.
lines.style: Closing the list with a practical note. Tone is slightly more grounded, less formal—the resource side of process. Steady, without hurry. The final check.
